channel.title: MyStat stable updates
channel.description: Stable releases for Apple Silicon on macOS 26 and 27.

item.title: MyStat 0.2.2
item.description:
MyStat 0.2.2 reduces the open dashboard's memory footprint with native AppKit/Core Graphics charts while preserving its readings, appearance, and 60-sample histories. On the tested M5 Pro, matched runs measured about 77% less memory (127.3 to 29.6 MiB); a one-hour soak at one-second refresh remained stable with a 33.3 MiB lifetime peak. Results vary by workload and hardware.
Fixes a Mach host send-right resource leak during CPU/memory sampling. Also reduces retained battery data and temporary sampling allocations, and reuses unchanged menu-bar images.
macOS 27 is now the primary target; macOS 26 remains supported until macOS 28 is released. macOS 27 power-sensor mappings remain experimental. Automatic update checks remain off by default; no telemetry or new runtime dependencies.
Tested with automated and real Sparkle integration suites, actual-app visual checks on macOS 26.6 and 27.0.1, 100 dashboard open/close cycles, and the physical-host one-hour soak. Substantial implementation and testing assistance from OpenAI Codex.
